produkt.takskyddet.title: Roof Cover for Travel Trailers & Motorhomes 18–44 ft (5.5–13.5 m)
produkt.takskyddet.body_html: A 6.5 × 3 m (21.3 × 9.8 ft) roof cover — for rigs up to 21 ft — that covers the roof surface and keeps rainwater away from roof hatches and seams through the winter.
produkt.takskyddet.meta_title: Roof Cover for Travel Trailers & Motorhomes 18–44 ft – CaraShell
produkt.takskyddet.meta_description: A dry roof until spring. 90-day guarantee
metafalt.takskyddet.opf.problem_rubrik: The rain sits right at the roof hatch
metafalt.takskyddet.opf.problem_text: Your travel trailer or motorhome sits outside all winter. Rainwater collects around the roof hatches and seams, and no one climbs up to check until spring — that's when the moisture check tells you whether the seals held.
metafalt.takskyddet.opf.losning_text: CaraShell covers the roof surface, with the edge hanging 30–40 cm (12–16 in) down over the sides, so rainwater doesn't sit at the roof hatches. Elastic straps with plastic hooks latch under the edge of the body and stay put in wind. One person can put it on alone.

produkt.termoskyddet.body_html: An exterior thermal cover, 211 × 171 cm (83 × 67 in), that keeps the cold and sun off the windshield and side windows and blacks out the cab when you sleep in the vehicle.
produkt.termoskyddet.meta_title: Windshield Thermal Cover for Motorhome 211 × 171 cm – CaraShell
produkt.termoskyddet.meta_description: No fog to wipe away in the morning. 90-day guarantee
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.problem_rubrik: The fog sits between the curtain and the glass
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.problem_text: Overnight moisture settles on the inside of the windshield, and a curtain just traps it between the glass and the fabric. Then the morning sun heats the cab to 86 °F (30 °C) before breakfast is ready, and at a rest area, everyone walking by can see straight in.
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.losning_rubrik: CaraShell sits on the outside of the windshield
metafalt.termoskyddet.opf.losning_text: The cover straps on over the outside of the windshield and both side windows, so the glass never gets cold on the inside. At the same time, it blacks out the whole cab: no one sees in, and the morning sun won't wake you at four a.m. Two minutes of work on the outside instead of fog to wipe away every day.

sida.returpolicy.body:
90-day guarantee

You have a 90-day guarantee from the day you receive the item to return it for a refund. The item must be returned in essentially unchanged condition.

How to return

Email hello@carashell.com with your order number before sending anything back — we'll tell you where to send it.

Refunds are made to the original payment method within 14 days after we receive the item.

Statutory Right to Complain

If the item is defective, the Swedish Consumer Sales Act (Konsumentköplagen) gives you the right to complain for up to 3 years. Contact hello@carashell.com with pictures of the defect.

sida.fraktpolicy.body:
Delivery Time

Standard delivery time is 5–10 business days from when the order is placed. An order confirmation is sent immediately by email, and a tracking number once the package leaves the warehouse.

Packages that aren't picked up are returned to us. We refund the item's price minus the cost of shipping both ways.

index.sections.sortiment.settings.title: The Collection
index.sections.berattelse.blocks.h.setti: Why CaraShell only covers what takes the beating
index.sections.berattelse.blocks.t.setti:
A full-body cover is supposed to protect everything at once. In practice, it's heavy, takes two people, and rubs against the paint when the wind picks up.

CaraShell only covers the surface that actually takes the beating: the roof through the winter, the windshield when you sleep in the vehicle. Less surface, faster to put on, and nothing rubbing against the rest of the vehicle.

sida.data-sharing-opt-out.title: Your privacy choices
sida.data-sharing-opt-out.body:
As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.

Sharing personal information for targeted advertising based on your interactions across different websites may be considered a "sale", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.

If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are located, we will treat this as a request to opt out of any activity that may be considered a "sale" or "sharing" of personal information, or other use that may be considered targeted advertising, for the device and browser you used to visit our website.
